objective: Split the five highest-priority North America queued/high-frequency supplement brands into one external discovery lane and one official recovery wave lane that can be executed without reopening broad expansion.

lanes.goal: Establish current, North America-valid product evidence and queue-presence for brands where current local recovery lanes are exhausted or canonical presence is missing.

brands.reasonIncluded: Largest missing-from-staging target in the top-five set, with current local recovery attempts exhausted and strong newly confirmed official North America coverage.
brands.recommendedExecution: Open a fresh official-site-led discovery lane using Natrol sitemap, category collections, product pages, label assets, and official-site Amazon cross-links.
brands.stopCondition: Stop if the brand still shows zero queue-presence or only low-confidence identity after official-site evidence normalization.

brands.reasonIncluded: Absent from the current canonical high-frequency report but discovery found the cleanest official sitemap/product/label surface in the batch.
brands.recommendedExecution: Do queue-presence verification first, then official-site-led ingestion only for validated current products from the Codeage NA storefront.
brands.stopCondition: Stop if queue-presence verification fails or if current products cannot be matched back to stable supplement identity without threshold loosening.

guardrails: Do not treat old queue artifacts as current truth without fresh verification.
Do not inflate signal from Amazon-only pages without official corroboration.
Keep iHerb optional because Cloudflare challenge is a known environment blocker.
lanes.successSignal: At least one brand in this lane produces validated current queue candidates or a blocker-grade proof that current recovery should remain paused.

lanes.goal: Push already-evidenced official-site recovery surfaces into concrete queue/high-frequency uplift without reopening broad discovery.

brands.reasonIncluded: Strongest active-queue recovery surface in the batch with very large official product JSON and supplement-facts coverage.
brands.recommendedExecution: Run an official Shopify JSON replay against the current active_queue using the P0 US strong-identity lane before weaker retailer-led paths.
brands.stopCondition: Stop if replay fails to produce net complete-hit uplift after one canonical merge and audit cycle.

brands.reasonIncluded: Large missing-from-staging tail plus strong official barcode-rich product JSON and prior local brand-expansion evidence.
brands.recommendedExecution: Replay an official-site-led recovery wave using current missing rows, barcode-rich product JSON, and known strong multivitamin/hair category coverage.
brands.stopCondition: Stop if current missing rows cannot be re-materialized into a fresh strong-identity queue.

brands.reasonIncluded: Small residual missing-from-staging tail with strongest clean official discovery surface in the whole discovery batch.
brands.recommendedExecution: Run a tightly targeted official/iGen replay only on the residual missing rows and close the tail rather than opening a broad brand expansion.
brands.stopCondition: Stop after the residual six-row tail is resolved or blocker-classified.

guardrails: Do not reopen exact-barcode lanes already proven no-signal for these brands.
Do not widen to retailer-first discovery when official-site evidence is already stronger.
Every wave must rerun merge plus canonical high-frequency validation before claiming uplift.
lanes.successSignal: At least one brand in this lane produces canonical high-frequency uplift that survives merge and product-surface audit.
